reviews.x: Sheds pretty heavy .... Very soft though. I love it. Wearing it for Vday

I am loving it so much! First time wearing a wig and the quality of the wig is better than I expected! It looks and feels so real! Not shining like other fake wig. I would recommend wearing a hat to cover the hair part tho. Definitely recommended! All my girls are ordering it! Cause they love how it looks on me!
I LOVE IT !!! It do shed A little but for the most part I love it and it fits perfectly along with the color .

reviews.t: It's a pretty wig soft and shiny however it's obvious one is ...
reviews.x: It's listed as Synthetic lace front wig yet it's NOT a  lace front. This is a wig. I purchased thinking it was a lace front as listed. It's a pretty wig soft and shiny however it's obvious one is wearing a wig. Keeping it for halloween.

reviews.t: All in all for $13 bucks it's a pretty good wig
reviews.x: This wig is really cute, but I have mixed feelings. It is very soft, but it does shed a lot. I found that after the first few uses the shedding decreased, but if you try to manipulate the part, some of the wig cap can become exposed and the hair pieces look strained. The part is really was makes it look unrealistic, but if you wear it with a hat, a beanie, or a thick hair band, it can pass as real.  I have blue hair I can't wear at work so when I serve tables, I put this on, put it in a messy bu
For 13$ it's an amazing wig!!! It's a bit shiny and sheds .. But again for 13$ it's amazing 😍

reviews.t: Natural but better with a hat
reviews.x: This wig is great! It comes with a netted wig cap (which i prefer more than a more fabric-like enclose wig cap) and its exactly the description. The hair is soft and nice quality. Though with the price you can't really expect a full on professional lace front wig but it can pull off a decent natural look. The part is a little difficult to style but you can just place the part at an angle and things will work itself out. It looks best with a hat.

reviews.t: i cut mine but i love ittt
reviews.x: greaaat wig i love it so much, people think its actually real haha. sheds a lot but not to where it looks bad. i straighten it sometimes to make it look better but i dont have the straightener too hot. also i wear headbands and hats to cover the part bc its very noticeable that its a wig at the top. (i cut it shorter too)

Absolutely LOVE this wig! The part is a little weird, but it was easily fixed with some bobby pins. It's a bit shiny, but I used dry shampoo and it's perfect now. Looks great, so glad I got it. I was nervous because of how cheap it was, but I honestly can't believe how good it is. It sheds a little, but so did my 50$ wig.

reviews.t: Great color! Sheds like Crazy, no real layers
reviews.x: I chopped of all my hair a few months back & while it's growing back I wanted to have some fun with wigs. This wig gives me actually what I wanted as far as color which is what I was hoping for but the rest of the wig could use some changes which you can easily do yourself. The layers are not like the first picture, there are slight layers but once the wig is on you can not really tell, I plan to cut it a bit so it looks more like the picture listed. The part is a bit awkward to me, I have a sma

This is by far my favorite wig I've ever bought, I've had tons of compliments and people think it's my actual hair. It's so soft and doesn't get knotted easily. For a synthetic wig, it's pretty awesome.

reviews.t: It even has a clasp to help secure it to your head!
reviews.x: I knew the wig was cheap compared to the $350 real hair wig in our local stores, so I didn’t know what to expect exactly. I am 100% satisfied with what I got, because it feels like real hair.
Literally my favorite wig I own and my most complimented wig. I cannot believe the quality!

reviews.t: This is a good wig - for $13
reviews.x: This is a good wig - for $13. I do wish I would've put that money towards a better wig, but as I said, for $13 I got what I paid for. The wig is true to color, the length is generous. The part is rigid and immoveable, but that should be expected because it isn't lace front. The "roots" are very flat, which makes the midsection of the wig appear unnaturally poofy from certain angles. The included wig cap is pretty sad, so if you plan on purchasing this wig, make sure to buy your own wig c

It was only $13 so I didn't expect much.. however it feels great for being synthetic, it's very long, and it's verrryyy thick! It looks natural once you put foundation on the hairline, get rid of shine and cut some shape to it. I must have a tiny head because it does not fit well around my ears at all, other than that the wig it's self is tight enough with the straps in the back. I love it!

I LOVE this wig! There are only 2  downside is the roots, there's a purple hue to the black in the light & that it's a tad frizzy looking, but besides that it's a good wig. Oh & a little tip, if you want the hair to the side just pull it to what side you want. (That's what I did in the picture)

Ok so I love this wig it had very little shedding it stopped after a couple of combinings love the silver part ..it's adjustable and fits great"I have a big head". looks about the same as model shown only difference is the slightly slanted bang isn't there so I had to do a little slipping..also I felt the top hair color did not match for my skin tone and I didn't love the middle parting "my hair is usually parted to the side so it looked odd" but that problem is easily solved

reviews.t: Okay for a first time wig.
reviews.x: You get what you get for the price. The wig has a strong smell. Its unpleasant like i guess you could say chemical smell. Ive tried adjusting it but no matter what it hurts alot on my head compared to my other wigs. I would only wear for some quick selfies. But i would jot wear out because it is very uncomfortable. The front it very un natural which makes me wear a beanie over it to cover it up. It started to look okay when i parted the wig on the side.

I am pleasantly surprised with this wig! While it's very thin in the back and shows the wig cap, it's still pretty decent. Like many reviewers have mentioned, you can just wear a hat. I'm a cancer patient so I have no hair and this wig looks really close to what my hair looked like before I lost it all. Anyway, I think it's well worth the money and it's also way way more comfortable than my more expensive wigs. I can't wait to wear it out :)

Wow what a fantastic wig!! Looks great. Some parts are a little shiny so gonna use some dry shampoo product to dull it a bit. I cut about 2 inches off as it was a tad bit long for me. I also changed the part slightly at the front of hairline. The ombre effect is awesome and the Brown hair matches my own. Will purchase more from this seller. With prime shipping and the 13.00 for the wig cannot be beat. Love it!

I love it very much! It arrived as it said it would which was within a week.  The wig feels like real hair and its not very shiny. It looks even more realistic with a hat of some sort. The only problem I have with it is that it sheds a lot. However, it's good for its price and I'm happy with the purchase. I would definitely purchase again!

cool wig, though the synthetic hair clung to every shirt I tried on, like octopus tentacles.... : / The hairline was not as natural as I prefer, constantly felt like I had to adjust it which made me too self conscious. Overall, It was a return.
I hated it at first, but I cut it (I'm not good with hair..) it's okay now. With a hat. ^^

The product is as shown in the pictures. This hair is so soft! It's like human hair! Be prepared to have ALOT of hair on your head so thining it or cutting it to shape your face is a given. But it can definitely pass as real hair.  For a synthetic wig, it's not shiny at all and it doesn't tangled much;but it does shed ALOT. Shipping took about two weeks. If your looking for silver/grey hair this is it :)

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig as soft, natural-looking, and a great value for its low price.
Many reviewers note that the wig sheds, though some say it lessens after initial uses.
Several reviewers mention the wig is shiny and that the part/hairline looks noticeably fake, often recommending hats, headbands, or styling to cover it.
Some reviewers point out it is not a true lace front despite the listing, with a rigid, immoveable part.
A few reviewers note fit issues or wish they had spent more on a better wig.
